scope: Read-only GLB and source verification. No rendering, gameplay acceptance, fit acceptance, or production promotion.

policy.upperRobe: T50 removes redundant crossing chest bands and their tiny trim; only its silver neckline rim gets finer sampling. T50 cloth and lining only lose bounded crossing-band samples, with no added or altered samples. T70 upper robe cloth stays exact.
policy.rearRobe: T70 replaces two rear flanking cloth panels with raised scales. The original authored panel loft and gold frames stay exact; the new scale carrier adds up to 4 mm clearance inside fixed edges, with its backing recessed 1 mm. All other samples stay exact.
policy.preservedDefect: Only existing zero-length hood lining normals may remain. All other normals must be finite unit vectors.
policy.limits: Bounds and changed samples do not establish fit, clearance, movement quality, or visual acceptance. Root browser gates own those checks.

geometry.compareMethod: Multiset of complete vertex attributes, material name, bone/deform hint and transform. No mesh order correspondence.
